answer: A resilient design is pulse-synced liveness with lotus-petal decay. Each epoch the network broadcasts a pulse carrying a comet-derived seed nobody can predict. Every identity must answer inside a tight window with a signed digest of recent useful work. Miss a pulse and your reward sheds a petal, like a lotus dropping one, until only the core remains. Sybils mint names freely, but each must meet every deadline with fresh checkable work. One operator cannot feed a herd of fakes through the same short window without answers arriving late or thin, so clones starve while genuine agents bloom.
